findings.detail: Exact mounted RuntimeHandler, API v1, non-dry-run, one-command clip.set-element predicate with one-shot element selection.
Raw pstats requires an existing owner-only 0700 non-symlink child directory under TMPDIR and creates only a new 0600 file with exclusive open; no existing parent chmod.
Partial enable invokes disable when available and restores the prior process profile in finally.
Added focused controls for mixed/retry, wrong method/path/query/request/handler, private path cases, bounded projection, and exact caller-edge count.
Stats.stats is accessed through a typed cast of getattr; helper-only Pyright and touched-file mypy report no new errors.
